method: Three rounds of 5 random generated items per chapter (95 items per round, 285 in all, across mastery bank, practice forms and mocks) re-solved independently against NCERT Biology XI; every computed item (ploidy, chromosome number and DNA content through mitosis/meiosis, Chargaff percentages, nucleotide and H-bond counts, Calvin-cycle ATP/NADPH, Krebs-cycle yields, ATP balance, RQ from balanced equations, growth rates, lung volumes and capacities, minute volume, cardiac output, GFR and reabsorption) recomputed by hand; all fact-table groups checked for mutual exclusivity before the rounds
fixes: blood groups: the draft 'which group must NOT be transfused' item could offer two incompatible groups (e.g. B and AB for a group-A patient); replaced by an antigen item, so every option set has exactly one correct answer

mixed-category groups removed so MCQ distractors are always of the same kind: neuron types vs ANS divisions, accessory excretory organs vs excreted substances, Whittaker's criteria vs kingdoms, light-reaction vs dark-phase products, ETS components vs Krebs steps, occupational vs other lung disorders, symmetry vs coelom groups in Animal Kingdom

wording: 'A a dog cell' (article doubled) in chromosome-number items; long answers repeated 'Is it X or Y – X or Y?'; feature-table 'Give differences' turned off for non-contrastive tables (properties of life, floral parts, ECG waves, kidney regulators); 'aestivation' in the frog chapter now says '(in frogs)' to avoid clashing with floral aestivation

3-mark mock section (7 × 3) uses only families written for 3 marks (hand-written q3 items and a generated 'three differences' item) via a custom 'k3' mock kind; the 2-mark section excludes 3-mark items
note: No wrong answer key was found in the three sampled rounds after the fixes above; bank regenerated and revalidated.
